title: Scout S3: kgpt web client — Cowork, Projects, Library and api client; what a repo panel with diff view and proposal buttons needs
spec: Read-only scout over /Users/k3ntaw/code/kgpt/clients/web. Read src/components/Cowork.tsx, src/tabs/Projects.tsx, src/tabs/Library.tsx, src/lib/api.ts (and any api types under packages/api-types), the file viewer component the Library uses, and how proposals render inline in chat (search for proposal in src). Report: (1) component tree for Cowork mode and the project view, with path:line; (2) how data is fetched (react-query keys, api functions) and how mutations invalidate; (3) the existing file viewer and whether a diff view exists anywhere (search for diff); (4) how a button in the UI can create a proposal or start a chat turn today (is there a POST that files a proposal directly, or only via chat?); (5) design tokens and component conventions to follow (DESIGN notes, Tailwind classes, icon set); (6) build and typecheck commands and where generated API types come from (make api-types). Then propose the smallest UI addition set for: repo binding display, Refresh button, changed-files list, per-file diff view, Commit and Open PR buttons. Cite path:line, one confidence per finding.
acceptance: Result maps Cowork/Projects components and api functions with path:line
Result states whether a diff viewer and a direct proposal-creation route exist, with evidence
Result proposes the minimal component and api additions with an estimated file list

findings.claim: Cowork mode's component tree is: Cowork (default export) containing NewProjectDialog (conditional), a project <select>, folder/zip toolbar, and a scrollable tree of FolderRow (recursive, holds child FolderRow + FileRow) and root-level FileRow.

The project view is ProjectPanel (title, file/thread counts, archive toggle) composed of Instructions (standing-instructions textarea) and Contents (Files list + unfiled-file picker, Conversations list + unjoined-conversation picker); it renders inside Cowork rather than as its own tab.

Data fetching uses @tanstack/react-query with keys ['projects', includeArchived], ['tree', projectId], ['project-files', projectId], ['library'], ['conversations'], ['preview', attachmentId], ['rendered', attachmentId]; all api functions live in src/api.ts's `api` object and call the gateway via a shared `json()`/fetch wrapper.

Mutations invalidate by calling queryClient.invalidateQueries with the affected keys in onSuccess — e.g. createFolder invalidates ['tree', projectId] and ['projects']; fileInProject invalidates ['project-files', projectId], ['library'], ['projects']; there is no global cache-clear or optimistic-update pattern.

The only file viewer is Preview.tsx: it fetches /files/{id}/preview (structured JSON: sheets/slides/blocks/text) and optionally /files/{id}/rendered (LibreOffice-to-PDF), and switches between a structured view and a rendered picture/PDF by file kind (image, pdf, slides, table, document, text, page).

No diff view exists anywhere in the web client or the wider kgpt repo. `grep -ri diff` over clients/web/src only matches comment prose (e.g. 'differ', 'difference'), never a diff renderer, and there is no repo/git/commit/pull-request concept anywhere in the codebase, client or server (grep for repo/repository/git/commit/pull_request turns up only unrelated homelab-doc comments and an unrelated Sidebar `commit()` rename-field helper).

open_questions: No backend concept of a bound git repo, diff, commit, or PR exists anywhere in kgpt (gateway or DB models). A repo panel needs new gateway endpoints (bind repo, status/changed-files, diff-per-file, commit, open-PR) and new OpenAPI-generated types before the web client can call anything real — this is a backend design gap, not just a frontend gap.

Should 'commit' and 'open PR' be modeled as a new Proposal kind (so they get the existing approve/reject + audit trail for free) or as a wholly separate direct-action endpoint like /requests? The existing pattern strongly favors reusing the proposal machinery for anything mutating.

Is the repo scoped per-project (like the existing file tree) or a new top-level entity? The task's phrasing ('repo binding display') suggests binding one repo to a project, mirroring how files are already filed into a project.
suggested_next: Minimal web-side addition set (assuming new gateway endpoints exist): (1) clients/web/src/api.ts — add types RepoBinding, RepoStatus (changed files with path/status), FileDiff (unified-diff text or added/removed line arrays), and functions api.repoStatus(projectId), api.repoDiff(projectId, path), api.commitRepo(projectId, message), api.openPullRequest(projectId, title, body); (2) new clients/web/src/components/RepoPanel.tsx — repo binding header (owner/name/branch) + Refresh button (invalidateQueries(['repo-status', projectId])) + changed-files list styled like FileRow/FolderRow rows with an added/modified/deleted badge, each row selectable to drive the diff view; (3) new clients/web/src/components/Diff.tsx — per-file unified diff renderer (+/- line coloring using the existing allowed/denied tokens, monospace, reusing the <pre> block styling already used in Preview.tsx's text view and Message.tsx's tool-args view); (4) wire RepoPanel into Cowork.tsx next to the file tree, gated on projectId; (5) Commit and Open PR as buttons that open a small dialog matching NewProjectDialog's modal pattern, and that go through useMutation with the same onSuccess-invalidate + onError-inline-message pattern used throughout Cowork.tsx/Projects.tsx. Estimated files: 1 edit (api.ts) + 1 edit (Cowork.tsx) + 2 new components (RepoPanel.tsx, Diff.tsx), plus the corresponding packages/api-types regeneration once backend endpoints land — 4 web files touched, 1 generated.
